execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
  m.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  m.pref_name AS compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM molecule_dictionary m
JOIN compound_records cr ON m.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4419170'
ORDER BY m.chembl_id, m.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles
```
